$jsonSchema.title: Feedback Schema
$jsonSchema.description: Validation schema for the feedback collection - user feedback on recommended dishes

user_id.description: Reference to user._id - who gave the feedback

ai_recommendation_id.description: Reference to ai_recommendation._id (optional) - which recommendation this feedback is for

dish_id.description: Reference to dish._id - which dish this feedback is about

liked.description: Whether user liked (true) or disliked (false) the dish: true when rating is 3 or more

rating.description: Star rating the user gave the dish (1-5)

updated_at.description: Last time the user changed the rating
